_validation_note: 14-day window broadened to 21 days (May 28–18 June) and all four candidates re-evaluated. No mechanism survived all seven gates. Candidate A (Alaska LNG HB 381 — Glenfarne-Enstar RCA Stack): Gate 3 FAIL — the mechanism's central structural layer (HB 381-created $16/Mcf price cap and cost-overrun prohibition on RCA gas supply contracts) is a prospective statute that has not been enacted; anatomizing it as a current regulatory layer is confabulation. All RCA primary-source URLs (rca.alaska.gov, akleg.gov statutes) returned HTTP 403 or 503. DOE LPO Layer 5 primary source returned HTTP 404. Gate 4 FAIL — the confirmed news trigger (KTUU June 17, 2026) does not mention the RCA, Enstar, data centers, or AI; the AI consequence requires two inferential steps and is not directly established by any fetched source. Governor sign/veto (Layer 2) passes Gate 5 (single-actor binary confirmed by Alaska Constitution Art. III Sec. 15), but Gate 3 and Gate 4 failures are disqualifying. Candidate B (Cook Inlet LNG Import Authorization Stack): Gate 5 FAIL — the binary authorization decision is a 5-member FERC commission vote; the FERC OEP Director's pre-filing acceptance is ministerial, not the authorization binary. No reframing eliminates this structural defect. Candidate C (Army Janus Fort Wainwright Microreactor OTA): Gate 1 fails at 14 days (ExecutiveGov article confirmed May 28, 2026, outside June 4–18); at 21-day broadening Gate 1 would pass but Gate 3 FAIL (Fort Wainwright garrison commander unnamed in all fetched sources; GVEA cooperative board has no single named decision-maker; DIU website returned ECONNREFUSED, OTA contracting authority structure unconfirmable) and Gate 5 FAIL (Army.mil article names Higier as Energy Portfolio Director but establishes only an institutional MOA between Army and DIU, not Higier's unilateral signing authority for Fort Wainwright awards). Candidate D (AIDEA Alaska Data Corporation LLC): Gate 1 FAIL — Northern Alaska Environmental Center is a nonprofit advocacy organization, not an independent editorial outlet; underlying board action is January 2026, outside both windows. Gate 5 FAIL — AIDEA board is a 9-member multi-member body. No mechanism survived the 21-day broadening. This is the fourth consecutive no-target run (June 12, 15, 16, 18). The bar was not lowered.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Cook Inlet LNG Import Authorization Stack
dropped_mechanisms.gate_detail: Gate 5: The binary authorization decision for any LNG import terminal — the FERC Section 3 NGA authorization order — is issued by the 5-member FERC commission, a multi-member body that explicitly fails the chokepoint asymmetry requirement. The FERC OEP Director's pre-filing acceptance is a ministerial administrative step, not the binary authorization. No reframing eliminates this structural defect. Additionally, the Petroleum News June 14 article returned HTTP 403 and could not be confirmed; the verified LNG Prime article is June 3 (within 21-day window), but the Gate 5 failure is determinative.
